title: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a Splunk SOAR user who can edit and run playbooks for a permitted container label…
description: Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0 contain a vulnerability where a user with permission to edit and run playbooks for a specific container label can manipulate playbook automation for containers they are not authorized to view. This occurs because the Playbook Automation API does not verify that a supplied playbook run identifier is bound to the correct execution context. Exploitation requires an existing running playbook on a container label outside the user's permitted view.
